text:
sophia_support: Heads up — customer AcmeCorp reports console hourly usage has zeros for 03:00–08:00 UTC (last 6 hours). They say API calls succeeded. Anyone seeing ingest lag? @mike_eng-analytics @raj_infra :eyes:

mike_eng-analytics: Looking... not seeing a global alert yet. Any tenant IDs? sample: acme-123

sophia_support: tenant=acme-123, reported at 09:12 UTC. Dashboard hourly table shows rows for other tenants but this one empty.

raj_infra: I see consumer lag spike on usage-ingest-kafka around 03:10–03:40 UTC. offsets behind ~250k. Possibly consumer restart triggered rebalancing.

ingest-monitor: alert: kafka_consumer_lag > 100k for group=usage-ingest (03:08-03:45 UTC)

mike_eng-analytics: Can you paste the worker pod logs where it crashed?

raj_infra: Restarted a few pods around 03:20 due to OOM. Logs show write timeouts to s3 uplink:
```text
ERROR 2025-02-12T03:19:57Z writer::parquet - upload failed: connection reset by peer
WARN  2025-02-12T03:20:01Z consumer::commit - commit failed: NotLeaderForPartition
```

sophia_support: Customer also says they retried, still no backfilled hours. Is there an automatic replay/backfill?

mike_eng-analytics: We have a replay job but it requires offsets to be available. If events were skipped due to OOM and not committed, we may have a gap. I'll check the CDC offset map.

raj_infra: Found that the partition owner changed; some messages landed in a compacted segment with tombstones. Replays won't surface those. Need manual reingest or backfill from raw parquet store.

sophia_support: ETA for fix? Customer is escalating, possible billing mismatch.

mike_eng-analytics: Short-term: manual backfill from raw parquet for tenant acme-123 for hours 03:00–08:00 UTC. I can run it in ~45m. Long-term: add consumer soft-retry and drain before restart.

sophia_support: Please keep me posted, I'll prepare a postmortem note for the customer. If you want me to loop in CS lead @andrew_cs let me know.

raj_infra: Also adding an action item: improve deploy bot drain hooks. Filed infra ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-8123

mike_eng-analytics: kicking off manual backfill now, will post log when done.

deploy-bot: redeploy usage-ingest v2.4.1 -> v2.4.2 (reason: bump backoff & graceful shutdown)

mike_eng-analytics: backfill complete for acme-123 hours 03–08 UTC. Rows visible in console. Closing loop with customer.

sophia_support: awesome, closing ticket after confirmation from Acme. :thumbsup:
